findings.arbiter_reasoning: M9 (catch the INSERT error and return) survived. On inspection it is EQUIVALENT for this test's error class, not a fake test: postgres.js 3.4.9 records uncaughtError on every transaction query via handler's q.catch and rethrows it after the callback resolves (node_modules/.pnpm/postgres@3.4.9/node_modules/postgres/src/index.js:290-296), so the original PostgresError is re-raised and rollback runs whether or not the helper catches. Reclassified from P0-candidate to a P2 false-comment finding; the candidate row was then resolved to killed by M9b.
